ugc.title: What is AI UGC?
paras: UGC means user-generated content. Here, a creator-style ad uses an AI-generated person and casual phone-video framing; it is not a real customer review or endorsement.

An [AI UGC video ad](page:video-ads) gives you that look without hiring a creator or shipping your product to anyone. You upload a photo of your product, pick a style or describe the scene, and AIVideosUGC makes a 6, 10, 15 or 30 second clip built around your real product.

The people in these clips are generated by AI, not real customers, so use them to show the product rather than as reviews. Captions, music and prices go on afterward in your editor or ad tool, where you control every word.

faq.q: What can I make with AIVideosUGC?
faq.a: Short video ads, product and unboxing videos, white-background photos, lifestyle photos, model photos and social ad images. Most start from a photo of your product.
A clear photo of the product you sell, with the whole item in frame. A phone photo on a plain background works well. Only upload photos you own or have permission to use.

faq.q: Can I use a product page link to start a video?
faq.a: Yes. Paste the link into URL to Video, choose the size and length, and you see the cost before the job starts.

faq.q: How much does a video or photo cost?
faq.a: Each job shows its credit price before you start. A photo or a 6-second clip is 24 credits, a 10-second clip is 40, 15 seconds is 60 and half a minute is 120. Credits for a failed job go back to your balance.

faq.q: Is the person in the video a real creator?
faq.a: No. The people in these clips are generated by AI, so show the product with them rather than presenting the clip as a customer review. Some platforms ask you to label AI-generated content.

faq.q: Can I make multiple versions for A/B testing?
faq.a: Yes. Run the same photo with different scenes, actors or openings, then split-test the downloads in your ad platform. You do not need another shoot.

faq.q: Can I run these videos as paid ads?
faq.a: Yes. Downloads are watermark-free and licensed for commercial use on TikTok, Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and marketplaces. Add your own captions, prices and offers and follow each platform's AI labeling rules.

faq.q: Do I need to hire a model or creator?
faq.a: No. The results are generated from one product photo, so there is no casting, sample shipping or filming date. Present the people in clips as part of your ad, not as customer reviews.
